correctness.rationale: PASS: The specified utility symmetry and strict increase imply exact rank ordering for own-color counts k=0,1,2: utilities (1,2,0) up to ordinal rescaling. For nonadjacent opposite swaps, k↦2−k, so both gain exactly when both are color-block interiors; for adjacent opposite swaps each k↦1−k, so both gain exactly when each is isolated, equivalent to a cyclic 0101/1010 factor. Explicit run constructions cover all splits except balanced six, whose run cases exhaust the possibilities. Inclusion-exclusion on a three-bit de Bruijn transfer graph gives the exact E_nb coefficient traces. Independent direct payoff enumeration through n=13 matched forbidden patterns and all sample counts; separate exact sympy characteristic polynomials gave t²(t^6−t^5−2t³+1) and t²(t³−t−1)(t³+t−1) and the stated E_6,3, E_7,3, E_8,4, E_10,5, E_12,6. Perron–Frobenius primitivity/strict spectral radius inequality gives S_n~2λ^n and λ<2. The all-n existence and asymptotic claims rely on the proved run constructions and transfer matrix argument, not finite checks.

value.rationale: PASS: A natural exact question about game equilibria on a basic graph family is resolved: one unique split obstruction despite exponentially sparse stable labeled configurations. The forbidden-word characterization connects bilateral incentives to regular languages, supplies usable exact counts and an asymptotic density; unlike an isolated negative example, it characterizes every admissible split and placement.

final_claim: In fully occupied two-color cycle swap games with single-peaked utility maximum Λ in (1/2,1), bilateral strict stable configurations are exactly circular binary words excluding alternating length-4 factors and simultaneous 000/111 triples; only the balanced six-cycle lacks equilibrium, with exact weighted transfer counts and S_n~2λ^n.
limitations: An unindexed specialist cycle transfer enumeration could contain equivalent forbidden-word characterization and exponential base.
